encode_batch_of_messages: encode a batch of messages into compressed byte arrays using arithmetic coding with a custom CDF function
decode_batch_of_messages: decode a list of compressed byte arrays back into messages using arithmetic coding with an inverse CDF function
enqueue_single_symbol: enqueue a single symbol into the compressed integer array using arithmetic coding range narrowing
dequeue_single_symbol: dequeue a single symbol from the compressed integer array using arithmetic coding range decoding
jax_encode_backend: run the JAX encoding backend to compress a message array into a bit array with a given CDF function
